notes.title: Update: Make your own TV Shows + new scenes, heads+
notes.notes:
The normal version has been updated with about 15 new scenes + a gang of new heads + a few bodies + small improvements.

[url=https://discord.gg/KRrXChuR6p]Join our discord to get the latest news[/url] as we post dev update there daily/weekly.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190375/fec3d4a4e83fe099c92f51e17ae4987681e487dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190375/4cd6dc8c861be55eacbc89c93a3903503f40c4d0.png[/img][/url]

*The biggest part of this update is the inclusion of some tools to help you make your own custom TV Shows currently on the Testing branch.

Check the following tutorial by our product manager Bob A. Merkintok on how to use the new tools and make your own Tv Shows- pull your dialogue in from 4chan at your own risk.

[previewyoutube=vGj85Z40DPI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to see some footage from the built in TV shows check this. 

[previewyoutube=HoDfGDfWsZk;full][/previewyoutube]

*To enable Tv Show mode open the console by holding SHIFT + press ESC- type "Show" when you see the ShowModeToggle click it and Submit- now when you enter Tv Mode it will play Tv Shows. See the tutorial posted above for more info and a detailed tutorial on how it works.

notes.title: Small Typewriter changes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=6dFr-S-c5Jg;full][/previewyoutube]

The Typewriter is pretty gud breh for making stupid raps and other easy/dumb dialogue animations-

I fixed the formatting on the text files used to store the TypewriterData- they are now human readable/easy to edit if you want to edit them outside of NP

There's two new buttons on the Typewriter menu-

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AXcXsgy.png[/img]

The blue "Open file" buttons opens the location of the TypewriterData text file on your PC, you can edit/save it directly-

The "Open file" button next to it allows you to load a TypewriterData file from your PC- for example- you sent it to your friend who modded it and sent it back to you etc

If you want to get serious about editing these files [url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/blob/master/Typewriter.md]GO HERE[/url] to get all the details

notes.title: Fixed bug/crash from last update + troubleshooting tips
notes.notes:
Last update introduced a bug that would crash NP on the main menu- sorry about that-

Fixed that bug and changed all other parts of the code that were susceptible to the same bug-

In the future if you're getting crashes, you can go to the other settings menu and press the "Delete saved data and quit" button on the bottom right
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KoLBRJw.jpeg[/img]

Then try launching NP again-

If that doesn't fix the issue press the "Show Player Log" button

Copy the "Player" file and send it to me/post somewhere I can access in one of these places

[url=https://discord.gg/twSWUXrY4p]The bug report channel on our Discord[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1355310/discussions/]On the NP Steam discussions page [/url]

[url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/issues]Post it as an issue on our Github page[/url](requires free Github account)

notes.title: New Beta with small bug fixes + more updates soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38190375/d6915152fb74d3171da2057a81062794157de446.jpg[/img]

If you didn't know- Imagination Rabbit is also a film/animation studio. The image above is a spec poster from our new animated feature film "M doll".

* Notice that the second head from the bottom is an NP head that we painted a different texture on.

You can check out the teaser trailer here
[previewyoutube=xHz_pQWRAu8;full][/previewyoutube]

We were away from working on Nightmare Puppeteer as we were working on that film. Our work on the film is now finished so its back to Nightmare Puppeteer!

Btw- we used NP to produce a few segments used in the film itself.

We just uploaded a new update to NP on the BETA branch which fixed a few bugs that were submitted from users. If you submitted a bug in the past 6 months or so check its status [url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/issues]here[/url] as we might have added a fix for it.

If you are still having issues please reply or submit a new issue to our [url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/issues]github page[/url]- thanks!

We will continue to work through those issues while prototyping some crazy new features in NP in our quest to MAKE EVERYTHING STRANGER.

Please submit your feature requests to our [url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/issues]github page[/url] or as a comment to this post.
